test_save_and_load_tokenizer: test the CommonTokenizerTester.save_and_load_tokenizer method to verify tokenizer serialization and deserialization round-trips correctly
test_pickle_tokenizer: test the CommonTokenizerTester.pickle_tokenizer method to verify tokenizer can be pickled and unpickled without losing tokenization behavior
test_add_tokens_tokenizer: test the CommonTokenizerTester.add_tokens_tokenizer method to verify adding custom tokens and special tokens updates vocab size correctly
test_required_methods_tokenizer: test the CommonTokenizerTester.required_methods_tokenizer method to verify tokenize, encode, convert_tokens_to_ids, convert_ids_to_tokens, and decode work correctly
test_pretrained_model_lists: test the CommonTokenizerTester.pretrained_model_lists method to verify max_model_input_sizes keys match pretrained_vocab_files_map keys
